code: import{useEffect}from"react";import Lenis from"lenis";export default function useLenis(){useEffect(()=>{const reduce=window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;if(reduce)return;const lenis=new Lenis({duration:1.15,easing:t=>Math.min(1,1.001-Math.pow(2,-10*t)),smoothWheel:true});let rafId;const raf=time=>{lenis.raf(time);rafId=requestAnimationFrame(raf);};rafId=requestAnimationFrame(raf);return()=>{cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);lenis.destroy();};},[]);}
